Settings

Language

Account

Remiel Sentinel keeps a private copy of your data on its server so you can use it on another device. Turn this off to keep everything on this device only.

Not connected yet
Not connected yet. Your data is saved on this device.

Remiel Sentinel keeps only a one-way fingerprint (a hash) of your number and email, never the number or address, and shows your name and Sentinel ID only to people who already have one of them saved.

Attach an email and password to this account. Then sign in with them on your other device to see the same data.

Location Sharing

Your location goes only to the people you choose below, and only while Remiel Sentinel is open on this device. Anyone in your Circle can ask; you answer each request. To see where others are, tap WHEREIS beside their picture.

Send my location while Remiel Sentinel is open
On whenever you share with someone below: updates every 30 seconds while the app is open. Turn off to pause sending to everyone.
Share my location with

Everyone linked with you in your Circle. They can also ask; you answer Allow always, Allow for 8 hours, or Not now.

Check in

Places of Circle members who receive your location. Tap a room to check in: the tap is your own action and is sent once.

A Place is a circle on the map that you name. Members who share their location with you are logged when they arrive and leave. A room comes only from the member's own tap or QR check-in.

Checking status...
Test urgent alarm
Sends yourself a Level 3 alarm. It repeats every 2 minutes until you tap Acknowledge on the red bar at the top of the screen.
Help button

Sends an urgent alarm to the person you choose. It rings on their screen and phone every 2 minutes until they tap Acknowledge.

Break Glass word
A silent Help. Type Break Glass (or just Glass on its own) in any message, check-in note or Ledger note, or say it while dictating. An urgent alarm goes to the person above with nothing shown on your screen. The message is still sent as normal.
Bluetooth safety

Tracker warnings, Find during an alarm and headcounts work in the Remiel Sentinel app from the App Store or Google Play, because browsers cannot use Bluetooth this way.

Warn me if an unknown tracker moves with me
Android: checks every 5 minutes while Remiel Sentinel runs. Warns when the same AirTag, Tile, SmartTag or similar tracker has been with you 3 times, over 30 minutes, in places 400 m apart.

On iPhone, Apple warns you itself about an unknown AirTag or Find My tracker moving with you. Check it is on: iPhone Settings, Privacy and Security, Location Services, on; and Bluetooth on. Check now still finds Tile and SmartTag trackers.

Findable during my own alarm
While an alarm you raised is open (Help, Break Glass), your phone sends a Remiel Sentinel signal so people in your Circle who got the alarm can find you within about 30 m. Off at all other times.
Count me present in headcounts
While Remiel Sentinel runs, your phone sends a Remiel Sentinel signal so a coach or lead in your Circle can count you present, for example on the bus.
Urgent alarms
After you, urgent alarms go to
If you do not tap Acknowledge within 5 minutes, the alarm moves to the next person, then the next. Only linked people can be chosen.
Also reach me by
Urgent alarms for you also go to this email.
Attention alerts stay silent between these times. Urgent alarms always ring.
For people who share their location with you: an Attention alert when they have not opened Remiel Sentinel for this long, and an urgent alarm at twice as long. It clears by itself when they are back.
Your emergency contact
When you send Help, this person also gets an email.

Circle Bio Monitor

Connect Bluetooth heart rate monitors and match each one to a person. Their ring pulses with their heart rate.

Connected monitors: None
No monitors connected. Tap "Add monitor" to look for Bluetooth heart rate monitors.

How it works: Each heart rate monitor connects over Bluetooth and is matched to one person. That person’s ring then pulses with their heart rate. This works in Chrome.

      Tour and tips

      Remiel Sentinel shows the people you care about as spheres around your own. You log calls, visits, moods and medications, and each person gets a status from Quiet to Urgent so you can see who may need you first. Your data is saved on this device, and a private copy is kept on the Remiel Sentinel server so you can use it on another device. You can turn that copy off in Settings, Account. People in The Circle see only what you turn on for them.

      Danger Zone

      Delete all contacts, moods, interactions, and settings from this device. Your server copy stays and returns when you sign in.
